move: glow swells, three phones slam in with motion blur, flash, pull back
how: On black, a purple radial glow scales 0.3 -> 1 and fades in over the first 33% of the 3s (power2.out). The centre phone slams up from y 900 with rotateX -40, scale 1.1 and filter blur(14px) to rest (expo.out, 0.7s) at 12%; the left phone comes from x -1000 with rotateY 60 / rotateZ -12 to x -300, rotateY 22, rotateZ -6 at 17%; the right mirrors it at 20%; the side phones sit at z -120. At 21% a white full-frame flash drops from opacity 0.85 to 0 (power2.out) while the group shakes x 0 <-> 8 six times. The title rises from yPercent 120 (expo.out) at 30%, the group drifts rotateY 8 with sine.inOut, and at 82% the phones recede to z -900 with opacity 0 and blur(10px) (power3.in, 0.04s stagger); glow and title fade so the frame returns to black.
adapt: Swap the three screen designs, the title text, the glow colour and the rest poses (x +-300, rotateY +-22). Keep the 0.7s move slams staggered 0.15s, the 0.35s flash and the 0.05s x6 shake.
port: mount(el, shot) builds .glow, .grp with three phones, .flash and .title; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with slams at 0.12D/0.17D/0.2D, flash at 0.21D, drift at 0.37D and exit at 0.82D. The from() tweens on the title should become fromTo with immediateRender:false; el needs perspective:1400px.
caveats: animates CSS filter blur(14px) on three phones with box-shadows, slow while in motion
the 900px radial glow is a large translucent layer
loop closes only because both end frames are black
